title: $CPB is DOWN -5.5% to $23.03 today.
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
The spark: no company news at all. The defensive staples trade that carried Campbell's up about 29% since early October is fading, and holders are cashing in.  
  
Packaged-food peers are off around 2%, so CPB is falling roughly 3x harder than its own group. Next real test: earnings on Dec 9.
